observations: Photo 0: one used car tyre standing upright on a concrete floor, shot straight at the tread; parts of other tyres at the edges.
Photo 0: wide asymmetric summer tread with four circumferential grooves and angled shoulder sipes; grooves still open along the visible section.
Photo 0: tread surface is dusty and scuffed; depth cannot be measured from this angle and no wear bars are shown.
Photo 0: the sidewall is not visible, so no brand, size or DOT date code is readable.
Photo 0: no patch, plug or bulge visible on the tread face shown; the inside of the tyre and the sidewalls are not shown.
Photo 0: a dealer watermark is printed across the tyre.
Only one tyre is shown; the quantity offered is not stated.

claims.evidence: The sidewall with the size marking is not shown in photo 0.
Nothing in photo 0 shows where the tyre came from.
Photo 0 shows open grooves but no depth gauge or coin in the groove and no wear bars; it does not look new.
The inside liner is not shown.
The DOT date code on the sidewall would show the tyre's age, not the car's.

risks.risk: Size, brand and load rating are unknown, and they set the price of a tyre.
risks.proof: Close photo of the sidewall showing brand, size and load/speed marking.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced; the size is needed

risks.risk: Tyre is old even if tread looks good, so the rubber is hardened or cracking.
risks.proof: Close photo of the four-digit DOT date code on the sidewall.
risks.if_unproven: as an old tyre near the end of its life

risks.risk: Tread is much lower than claimed.
risks.proof: Photo of a tread depth gauge or a coin pushed into the centre groove.
risks.if_unproven: as worn near the wear bars

risks.risk: Hidden patch, plug or inner damage.
risks.proof: Photo of the inside liner of the tyre under good light.
Photos of both sidewalls all the way round.

proof_requests: Close photo of the sidewall showing brand and the size marking.
Close photo of the DOT date code.
Photo of a depth gauge or coin in the centre groove.
Photos of both sidewalls and the inside liner.
How many tyres are offered, with all of them in one photo.
response.reason: Photo 0 shows a used wide tyre from the tread side only; the size and brand on the sidewall, which set the price, are not shown, so a sidewall shot is needed before even a worst case price can be set.
